canonical_statement: For a real predictable process H that is square-integrable on a finite time interval [0,T] and a standard real Brownian motion W on a filtered probability space satisfying the usual conditions, the Ito integral has second moment equal to the expected time integral of H squared: E[(integral_0^T H_t dW_t)^2] = E[integral_0^T H_t^2 dt].
